description: A world of floating continents held aloft by gravity crystals. Sky-merchants trade between islands, guilds hoard crystal-tuning secrets, and storms of shifting gravity make travel dangerous. Flight between continents depends on rare crystal-powered vessels. I am a poor apprentice engineer on a small trading island.

core.name: Aethelis
core.tagline: Where gravity bends, and trade floats free.
core.premise: A world of floating continents suspended by gravity crystals, where sky-merchants navigate treacherous storms of fluctuating gravity, and the balance of power rests in the hands of guilds that control crystal-tuning technology.
core.tone: Cinematic, grounded, tense, with a quiet realism amid chaos
core.intro: You wake in the damp shadows of a weathered workshop on the island of Veylra, your fingers stained with grease and the metallic tang of crystal dust. The sky above is a shifting mosaic of pale blue and bruised violet, and you can hear the distant hum of a vessel descending from the east—its wings like tattered wings of stone, trembling as it dips through the gravity currents. The air here tastes thin, and the ground beneath your feet is not solid, but a slow, breathing layer—

special_rules.name: Tune with Gravity Pulse
special_rules.summary: You can use a tuning wand to detect gravity fluctuations by aligning it with a pulsing crystal. When done, you learn the strength of the current wave.

on_success.text: You detect a stable gravity pulse. You now know the tide-rift will peak in 4 hours.

on_failure.text: The wand vibrates violently. You lose focus and drop it.

special_rules.name: Anchor with Tide Rope
special_rules.summary: You can use a tide rope to secure a floating vessel during a gravity pulse. If the rope is strong enough, it can hold the craft in place.

on_success.text: The vessel stays stable during the pulse. The crew reports no injuries.

on_failure.text: The rope snaps. You fall into the air—suffer 1 fatigue and lose balance.

special_rules.name: Repair with Clay and Gravity
special_rules.summary: You can use clay and a gravity staple to mend a cracked tuning wand. This is common among apprentices.

on_success.text: You create a new tuning wand—functional but not fully tuned.

on_failure.text: The clay cracks. You waste the effort.
